description: Minimal coding agent TUI, ported to TypeScript on Node.js
name: zerostack-ts

scripts.install-hook:
node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('.git/hooks/pre-commit', '#!/bin/sh
set -e
npm run check
', {mode: 0o755}); console.log('Pre-commit hook installation confirmed.')"
scripts.remove-hook: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.git/hooks/pre-commit', {force: true}); console.log('Pre-commit hook uninstallation confirmed.')"
scripts.sync-version: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; console.log('Version is ' + v + ' (single source of truth: package.json)')"
